posts.title: Bending Aspire to your will - Build a custom resource (Part 1)
posts.description: I spend a lot of time testing and debugging APIs, and so do my AI agents. Lately I notice that my agents lose time and tokens on it. They look for the right port, guess at endpoints, fight with a terminal, and try to get the database back into a known state. Every run starts with the same detective work. So for this series of posts I picked one scenario and I’m sticking with it: the API-testing lo
